## Featured Manuscript Workflows

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### DEEP-CORE-MANUSCRIPT
*Salt Marsh Metagenomics & Biogeochemical Function*

End-to-end bioinformatic workflows and statistical scripts supporting genome-resolved metagenomic analysis across salt marsh sediment depth profiles and nutrient enrichment treatments.

* **Key Features:** Metagenome assembly, MAG binning and refinement, functional gene annotation (nitrogen, sulfur, and carbon pathways), and depth-resolved community ordination.
* **Ecosystem Context:** Plum Island Ecosystems (PIE) LTER salt marsh sediments.
* **Repository:** [jvineis/DEEP-CORE-MANUSCRIPT](https://github.com) · Related: [DEEP-CORE](https://github.com) & [DEEP-CORE-cazyme-analysis](https://github.com-cazyme-analysis)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### MESOCOSM_18S
*Marine Upwelling & Planktonic Microeukaryote Succession*

Amplicon processing pipelines, taxonomic curation, and ecological modeling scripts for tracking diatom, dinoflagellate, and microeukaryotic community dynamics during simulated ocean upwelling.

* **Key Features:** High-resolution 18S rRNA sequence filtering, ASV/OTU clustering, niche specialization metrics, and time-series co-occurrence analysis.
* **Ecosystem Context:** Simulated coastal upwelling mesocosm experiments (Ward Lab, Princeton University).
* **Repository:** [jvineis/MESOCOSM_18S](https://github.com)
:::

:::

## Utilities, Marker Genes & Tutorials

In addition to manuscript-specific repositories, I maintain modular scripts and educational resources for environmental 'omics data processing:

| Repository | Description | Primary Stack |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **[my_sequence_utilities](https://github.com)** | Command-line scripts for quality filtering, formatting, and manipulating high-throughput Illumina sequencing data. | Python / Shell |
| **[marker-gene-analysis](https://github.com)** | Step-by-step scripts for read filtering, taxonomic assignment, phylogenetic inference, and visualization of key biogeochemical functional genes (*nrfA*, *nirS*, *dsrB*). | Python / R |
| **[DEEP-CORE-cazyme-analysis](https://github.com-cazyme-analysis)** | Template workflow for profiling carbohydrate-active enzymes (CAZymes) from short metagenomic sequencing reads. | Python |
| **[get-jgi-data](https://github.com)** | Practical tutorial and helper scripts for programmatically retrieving metagenomic project datasets from the Joint Genome Institute (JGI). | Python |
| **[med-anvio-workshop](https://github.com)** | Hands-on workshop materials, worked examples, and discussion guides for Minimum Entropy Decomposition (MED) and [Anvi'o](https://anvio.org). | Python / Shell |

---

## Reproducibility & Environment Standards

All workflows are structured to promote transparent, reproducible microbial ecology research:

* **Version Control & Documentation:** Analysis steps are documented with clear directory structures, parameter logs, and README guides on [GitHub](https://github.com/jvineis).
* **Core Tooling:** Built around standard open-source bioinformatics ecosystems including [Anvi'o](https://anvio.org), Python (`Biopython`, `pandas`), R (`tidyverse`, `vegan`, `phyloseq`), and Unix shell pipelines.
